value.rationale: The natural complete split graph is a standard diameter-two metric family. Its exact maximal negative-type exponent, sharp normalized negative-type spectral margin, minimal Euclidean snowflake embedding dimension, and complete first failure of ordinary 1-negative type are intrinsic geometric invariants not supplied by a generic existence criterion. The seven-vertex obstruction pinpoints the first loss of Hilbert snowflake embedding in a structurally motivated family; this is more than a small numeric example.
